input: Research overnight sleeper train routes across Europe

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Europe is vast — knowing which countries, corridors, or city pairs to focus on prevents wasted research on irrelevant routes and narrows the output to what is actionable.
Whether this is for a solo traveller, a couple, a family with children, or a group changes which berth types, compartment configurations, and pricing structures to prioritise.
A specific travel window affects which services are running (some are seasonal), timetable validity, and booking availability — all critical to accurate research.
Budget determines whether to focus on basic couchette berths vs. private sleeper cabins, and whether cost-comparison with flights is relevant.
Some travellers prioritise comfort and privacy, others eco-credentials, scenic routes, or rail pass compatibility — this shapes which routes and operators to highlight.
Knowing whether the end goal is booking a specific trip, building a general reference guide, or writing content determines how deep and structured the research needs to be.
The desired output format — a simple list, a comparison table, a saved document, or booked tickets — determines what 'done' looks like and what the immediate next action is.

gold.taskTitle: Research European overnight sleeper train routes
gold.taskDescription: Find and compile information about overnight sleeper train routes across Europe, tailored to specific travel needs and preferences.

questions.title: Which countries or city pairs should be included?
questions.description: Identify the geographic scope — whether this covers all of Europe or specific corridors (e.g. UK to mainland Europe, Scandinavia, Iberia, Eastern Europe).

questions.title: Who is travelling — solo, couple, family, or group?
questions.description: Clarify the number and type of travellers to ensure the right cabin and berth configurations are researched.

questions.title: When are you planning to travel?
questions.description: Establish a travel window or timeframe to ensure timetables, seasonal services, and booking windows are accurate.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget per person per night?
questions.description: Determine whether to focus on budget couchettes, standard sleeper berths, or premium private cabins.

questions.title: What matters most — comfort, price, scenery, or sustainability?
questions.description: Understand the traveller's priorities to weight the research toward the most relevant routes and operators.

questions.title: Is this for planning a real trip or general reference?
questions.description: Clarify whether the research leads to an actual booking or serves as an informational overview, which determines depth and specificity needed.

questions.title: What format should the final research output take?
questions.description: Decide whether the deliverable is a written summary, a comparison table, a saved document, or actionable booking links.
